echo_sets.name: Midnight Veil
echo_sets.note: Best-in-slot on Havoc teams: bursts Havoc DMG on Outro and grants the incoming Resonator 15% Havoc DMG Bonus. Lorelei passively raises her Havoc DMG and Basic Attack DMG.

echo_sets.name: Empyrean Anthem
echo_sets.note: First choice in non-Havoc coordinated-attack comps (e.g. Jinhsi teams): +10% Energy Regen and +80% coordinated attack DMG. Hecate further amplifies coordinated attack damage. Aim for ~70% Crit Rate to reliably trigger the set.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Budget early option that maximizes her Outro buffs for the next Resonator; outclassed by the two sets above once farmed.

build.energy_regen_target: 125-140% (her Liberation must be ready every rotation; Energy Regen main stat on a 3-cost and energy weapons help if uptime is an issue)
build.fast_path: Fast path: Whispers of Sirens + 5-piece Midnight Veil in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Lorelei in the main slot. Run Crit Rate/Crit DMG 4-cost, double Havoc DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, with Crit Rate, Crit DMG, and ATK% substats. For coordinated-attack-focused comps (e.g. Jinhsi teams), swap to 5-piece Empyrean Anthem with Hecate as the main Echo.

ranked_weapons.name: Whispers of Sirens
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. 72% Crit DMG, 12% ATK, 40% Basic Attack DMG bonus, and 12% Havoc resistance shred on the enemy — built to maximize her Echo Skill casts and off-field damage.

ranked_weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
ranked_weapons.note: Zhezhi's signature; strong Crit DMG substat and Basic Attack DMG stacking that carries to the off-field Outro buff.

ranked_weapons.name: Stringmaster
ranked_weapons.note: 36% Crit Rate with attribute DMG and off-field ATK bonuses; easy to balance the Crit ratio with.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: Standard 5-star Rectifier option; ATK% substat plus Energy Regen passive helps her costly rotations.

ranked_weapons.name: Augment
ranked_weapons.note: Best 4-star alternative (battle pass). Crit Rate substat plus ATK after Liberation.

ranked_weapons.name: Fusion Accretion
ranked_weapons.note: Grants Resonance Energy and ATK on Resonance Skill — decent F2P energy-gap filler.

stat_priorities.note: Crit Rate preferred on the Midnight Veil build; balance the Crit ratio against your weapon and substats.
Double Havoc DMG is standard; swap one to Energy Regen if her Liberation uptime is suffering.
ATK% on both; her kit scales with ATK.

build.weapon_filler_note: Call of the Abyss is a solid free-to-play 4-star placeholder with Havoc synergy; Jinzhou Keeper also works as an early-game crutch.

profile.role_note: Hybrid Sub-DPS / buffer / healer: off-field jellyfish coordinated attacks, Havoc + Resonance Skill DMG buffs via Outro, party healing through her Forte circuit. Built like a standard Sub-DPS with Crit stats.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: A niche, speculative pickup — strong only inside Havoc Echo Skill comps alongside Phrolova, where she dominates Whimpering Wastes. Versatile kit (off-field Havoc damage, coordinated attacks, healing, Havoc and Resonance Skill DMG buffs), but she lacks a perfect team outside that one comp and slightly loses out to generalist supports elsewhere. Pull when a rerun pairs her with Phrolova, not on her own.

members.name: Phrolova
members.note: The burst carry; deals most of her damage off-field, freeing Cantarella's combo time.

members.name: Cantarella
members.note: Echo Skill casts, coordinated jellyfish attacks, Havoc and Resonance Skill DMG buffs via Outro, plus team healing.

members.name: Roccia
members.note: Havoc amplification and crowd control; completes the highest-ceiling Havoc Echo Skill comp.

teams.name: Premium: Phrolova + Cantarella + Roccia
teams.rotation: Cantarella runs her full rotation first: Intro into basic attacks to stack Trance, Skill, Liberation for max Trance and coordinated attacks, Heavy Attack into Mirage, Flickering Reverie, enhanced basics for Shiver stacks, Perception Drain nuke and healing, then Outro into Phrolova for her Havoc DMG window. All three run 5-piece Midnight Veil; Roccia holds the team amplification.

members.name: Jinhsi
members.note: The burst carry; Cantarella's coordinated attacks feed Jinhsi's Incandescence stacks.

members.name: Cantarella
members.note: Runs Empyrean Anthem here; coordinated attacks plus a +25% Resonance Skill DMG Outro directly amplify Jinhsi's loop.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Healing and universal ATK buffs; keeps the team alive through the slower rotation.

teams.name: Alternative: Jinhsi + Cantarella + Verina
teams.rotation: Cantarella opens with her Intro-Skill-Liberation-Mirage rotation to activate coordinated attacks and stack Trance/Shiver, then Outro into Jinhsi's full burst combo. Note: this pairing strains Jinhsi's Liberation energy — build extra Energy Regen or accept slower cycles.

tier_badge.label: Strong niche Sub-DPS
tier_badge.note: Game8 (updated Aug 2026) rates her S inside the Havoc Echo Skill comp with Phrolova. Consensus across lists (Beebom 3.7, MMO Culture, Pocket Gamer) is A — treat her as A overall, S-level inside her signature comp.

sequences.verdict: Strong at S0, far more capable at S1. Chase S1 first, stop at S3 for value, S6 only for whales.
